game_title: Fallback: Loop Counter Conveyor – Hidden Spring
game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring, a hidden spring: the torchbearer must hold off zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring: a hidden spring
core_gameplay_loop: In Hidden Spring, repeat each round: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed. Then check belt_count and advance.
player_objective: Protect the supply cache from zombies in Hidden Spring: keep belt_count above zero until the 54-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Loop Counter Conveyor
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 4, Level 9, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
